_name: probe-2026-10-30-tcga-lineage - TCGA erlotinib and the mapping link
_superseded: 2026-11-09: retired with the TCGA rollback (operator 11-06: TCGA's sequencing is D.SEQ again, not A.ALN). Its A.ALN codes and the measured 54 describe the old shape; do not run it. The corpus cases graph.tcga_erlotinib_with_sequencing, graph.tcga_lung_patients_with_sequencing and graph.tcga_count_patients_with_sequencing (now D.SEQ) replace it.
_why: On 10-26 and 10-28 the unforced erlotinib question returned 0 (tasks 2586, 2829: T_D_SEQ required; TCGA holds sequencing as A.ALN; #143). Eight turns, one fresh chat each, plus the two consistency turns --tier full adds, PAID: needs the operator's go. Dev only.
_instance_warning: Dev only: TCGA is on dev, not on production. The number 54 was measured on dev on 10-28; the runner re-pins every count on the box with pin_probe_truths.py.

cypher: MATCH (p:T_PAT)-[:IN_STUDY]->(:Study)-[:IN_INVESTIGATION]->(i:Investigation {title:'TCGA'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) WHERE toLower(v.search_text) CONTAINS 'erlotinib' } AND EXISTS { MATCH (:T_A_ALN)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n

MATCH (p:T_PAT)-[:IN_STUDY]->(:Study)-[:IN_INVESTIGATION]->(i:Investigation {title:'TCGA'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) WHERE toLower(v.search_text) CONTAINS 'erlotinib' } AND EXISTS { MATCH (:T_A_ALN)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n

MATCH (p:T_PAT)-[:IN_STUDY]->(:Study)-[:IN_INVESTIGATION]->(i:Investigation {title:'TCGA'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) WHERE toLower(v.search_text) CONTAINS 'erlotinib' } AND EXISTS { MATCH (:T_A_ALN)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n
MATCH (p:T_PAT) WHERE p.Study = 'TCGA-LUAD' AND EXISTS { MATCH (:T_A_ALN)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) } RETURN count(p) AS n

MATCH (p:T_PAT)-[:IN_STUDY]->(:Study)-[:IN_INVESTIGATION]->(i:Investigation {title:'TCGA'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (v:T_PAV)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) WHERE toLower(v.search_text) CONTAINS 'carboplatin' } AND EXISTS { MATCH (:T_A_ALN)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(p) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n
